text: {"lessons":["These short-term gains and losses are unpredictable; past price movements do not reliably forecast what comes next.","Avoid reacting impulsively to a single period’s decline or rebound; review my portfolio calmly and infrequently, as suits my long-term approach.","Keep risk and diversification in mind, since losses feel especially painful to me, and make changes only when they fit my investment plan."]}
